changelog: Fixed OTA installer not triggering — SHA-256 APK verification moved to background IO coroutine (was blocking main thread causing ANR on Firestick)
Fixed Settings tab crash — Categories tab rebuilt as LazyColumn; eliminates 500+ simultaneous flow collectors that caused OOM on low-RAM devices
Improved search responsiveness — debounce increased from 300ms to 500ms to prevent rapid DB queries on D-pad scroll
Added TimeshiftManager: 15-minute live-TV ring buffer written exclusively to USB/OTG external storage via getExternalFilesDirs()
Recording engine: 512 KB async write buffer on dedicated IO coroutine eliminates USB I/O stalls
Category memory: all three ViewModels (LiveTV, Movies, Series) persist selected category and scroll position via SavedStateHandle
